title: Dhruv Rathee Interviews Former Chief Election Commissioner | Dr. S.Y. Quraishi
shows: A conversation in Hindi with S.Y. Quraishi, Chief Election Commissioner from 2010 to 2012. He describes how rolls were kept before the revision, by summary revision on each elector's own declaration and a booth officer's visit, and says the Commission now takes its decisions through the Chief Election Commissioner alone, where the law asks for unanimity where possible and a majority otherwise. He argues that Form 6 cannot lawfully be used to restore electors who were on the roll, because it carries a declaration that the applicant has never been enrolled, and proposes a separate form approved by the Law Ministry. He also says the West Bengal election should be held again because it was held on a roll he regards as unlawful, and criticises the Supreme Court for sending judicial officers to decide claims.
